translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Jesús Betzata-ti-chiid-nabal tule-keg-naneed-nudajad
Tegin Jesús machi-nudajad-cholbal, Judio-itoged-tummad-naigudanikidgin, Jesús Jerusalén-neg-kweburzhe nonimo.
Imi teun Jerusaléngin Oveja-Wanagak-tikalbal, ti-tummad wilagwal chii. Tenal ti-wilagwal-chiid Hebreo-kakagin nug Betzata. Tegin ti-wilagwal-chiid-tikalbal neg-matargana-kwaatal pukwamalbal.
Tenal we negmalgin, tule-yemalad-ichejul mamimal, tule-aku-atamalad, tule-mego-mego-nanemalad, tegin tule-tuwa-tinkualmalad. (Imi tule-yemalad ti-mumurmadagoed abintamamimal.
Tenal ti-chiidgin Pab-angel impa-impagin aktenonikil, ti omumurma-nonida. Tenal tule-yeed-keped ti-mumurmakedgin opchal, meke-ibi-poni we tulega nugunonida.)
Imi teun takalgu, tule-walgwen pirka-tulagwen-kakaambe-kakapábakkus, ti-mumurmaked-nabal yee mellemai.
Tegin Jesús tule-yeed-mellemai-takchagu, Jesús pato wiis we tule tikajulgus weob mellemai. Tegin Jesús tule-yeedzhe ekichial chogal: —¿Pe nugubi?
Tegin tule-yeed Jesúsga chogal: —Tummad, teobdo. Tenal an tule-kwen-nikchul an-chedgal, ti-mumurmanonikoedgin obgal. Tenal an alamanain obnegal, tenal tule-pid an-iktusda antu obgal. Al an keg nugu.
Tegin Jesús tule-yeedga chogalbal: —¿Teobí? Tegil imisgin an pega chog: pe kwisgu, tegin pe-kachi aga pe olmako, tegin pe nanao.
Tegidgin tule-yeed ilagwen nugunonijun. Tegin tule-yeed aga kachi olmas. Tegin tule-yeed kannamadi-kualzhun. Tenal teun ulukued-ibe nai.
Al Judiomal tule-nugujadga chogalmal: —Imi pe wichulzhí imis ulukued-ibe nai. ¿Ibiga pe olmakal kachi cheinatap-wede? Wedin izhe.
Tegin tule-nugujad Judiomalga chogal: —Imi tule-an-nudajad anka chogzhado: ‘Nanao.’ Tegin anka chogzhabaldo: ‘Aga pe kachi chedo.’ Al an kachi cheinatapto.
Tegin Judiomal tule-nugujadzhe ekichial: —¿Toa-tule pega chogzha-ade: ‘Pe nanao, aga pe kachi chedo?’
Tenal tule-nugujad wichuldo, toa-tule e-nudas. Tenal Jesús tule-nudasgu, tule-ichejulidbal Jesús tule-nugujadgin oweles.

Tegin Jesús tule-nudajad-cholbal untaradgin Jesús Pab-Tummadzhe-koled-neggin tule-nugujad-abingunonibal. Tegin Jesús tule-nugujadga chogal: —Imi pe takto, pedin nugus. Tenal pe imis-akar iskuedgin melle pal nanao, pega pul melle poni-tummad nononigal.
Tegin tule-nugujad Judiomalzhe nad, aga chognad Jesús e-nudas.
Imi Jesús ulukued-ibegin tule-nudas-choggu, al Judiomal chabzhul Jesús-imabi-kualmalzhun.
Tegin Jesús Judiomalga chogal: —Imi an-Pab pane-pane arpanai-choggu, al an pane-pane arpamo.

Tenal Jesús chogzhadbal ede Pab Tummadyob pane-pane arpanai, wedin chogle Pab Tummad Jesús-e-pab, tegin wedin choglebal Jesús Pab Tummadbak aga-a-yopí tule-tummadga maimo. Al Judiomal pul-pule Jesús-mesbi-kualmalzhun. Tenal Jesús ulukued-ibegin kwen ataszhulidbal, Judiomal Jesús-mesbi-kualmalbalzhun.
Pab Tummad Jesúsga igal-ukcha tule-otulogal, tegin tulemalga igal-itogalbal toa nos, o toa noszhul

Tegin Jesús Judiomalga chogalbal: “Imi an chunchunnad pemalga chogdo: imi Pab-Machi aga e-itolegedbal keg immal ima. Tenal Pab-Machi e-Pab-takel immal ima, ampa teopí Pab-Machi immal imamo. Tenal Pab Tummad meke-ibi-immalagin immal ima, e-Machi ampa teopí immal imamo.
“¿Ibiga teob? Imi Pab pela-pela aga e-Machi-pilal-choggu, al e-Pab pel-kwapa e-immal-imaked oyomo. Tenal Pab kujal e-Machiga pul-pule immal oyogo, pemal keger takegal.
Tenal Pab kannan tule-purkwalmalad-otulo-choggu, al e-Machi ampa e-Pab-yopí e-itolegedbal tule-purkwalmalad-otulomo.
“Teginbal, Pab Tummad tulega igal-kwen-itogojul-kuo. Tenal Pab e-Machiga igal-ukcha, tulemalga igal-itogal, tulemal piaje sapejul oturdaleged-wilubmal.

Tenal Pab e-Machiga weob igal-ukcha, tulemalde e-Machigin atamalgal, tulemal-pel-kwapa e-Pabgin atagedyobmo. Tenal tule Pab-Machigin kwen atajulil, Pab-machi-palmialidbal ampa Pabgin kwen atajulmalmo.”

Tegin Jesús chogalbal: “Imi an chunchunnad pemalga chogdo: meke-ibi-tule an-chunmajadgin ibzhajal, tegin Pab-an-palmialid-penguszhulil, we tule ilagwen-nadgu tullego, tegin we tule Pab Tummadzhe sapejul kwen oturdalegojulbal. Tenal tule Pabgin ibzhejal, tule-purkwed-igal-akar nos, tegin tule-ilagwen-nadgu-tulleged-igalgin tognonibal.

“Tenal an chunchunnad pemalga chogbaldo: tenal ibe noniko, tenal imi ibe pato naigunoni, tule-purpal-purkwalmalad mag itononiko Pab-Machi ibi chogzhad. Tenal tule-Pab-Machi-chogzhad-nued-itosmalad purpal tullenonimalo.
“Tenal Pab kusgu aga e-otuloged cheitii-choggu, al Pab aga e-Machiga igal-ukchamo, kusgu aga e-otuloged cheigalmo.
Tenal Pab-Machi, Te-Tule-Chunna-choggu, al Pab e-Machiga igal-ukchabal tulemalga igal-itogal tulemal piaje sapejul oturdaleged-wilubmal.
“Imi pemal melle an-chogzhadgin weob pakal peimalo. Tenal ibe nonikodo, tulemal-pel-kwapa-purkwismalad-uan-yabal-mamimalad Pab-Machi-chunmaked itomalo.
Tenal te ibegin, tule-purkwismalad uan-akar kwisgunonimalo. Tenal tule-nued-nanasmalad ilagwen-nadgu tullego, tenal tule-istar-nanasmalad ilagwen oturdaleged-neggin sapejul oturdalego.”
Jesús chogzhagujad, ede chunchunnad Pab-Machi-Chunnad

Tegin Jesús Judiomalga chogalbal: “Imi antin, an-itolegedbal keg walgwen immal ima, tenal Pab-anka-chogzhadbal an tulega igal-ito. Tenal antin tulemalga nuekwa igal-itogo piaje sapejul oturdaleged-wilubmal. Tenal an peiedyob an kwen nanejul, Pab-an-palmialid peiedyob, an nane.
“Tenal an naga walgwen chunmakelen, an chunmakeddin ib-nuedga kwen kunonikojulin.
Tenal imidin tule-pid ankin yer chunmadii. Wedin Juan Bautista. Tenal antin wisdo, we tule-ankin-chunmadiid, ib-chunchunnad.
“Imi pemal Juan Bautistaje tulemal-palminonimal. Tenal Juan pemalga napírra chogzhado, antin a-tuledo.

Tenal Pab Tummad ankin chunmajadbal, tegin an immal-taktijulmalad imajadbal, al an tule-kwen-napijul ankin chunmagal antin toa-tule. Tenal Pab-sapejul-tulemal-oturdakoed-akar pemal nabir abonolegal. Al Juan-ankin-chunmajadbal, an pemalga chognonimo.
Imi Juan Pab-wisgugal tulemal-oturdadi-kus, achachar-tummad kanaidgin neg-otarmanaidyob. Tenal pemal yabli ichéjal yer Juan-chogzhad wis itosmal.”

Tegin Jesús Judiomalga chogalbal: “Tenal antin, an-immal-imanaidbal Juan-ankin-chogdi-kujadga, pul-pule pemalga oyonai, antin toa-tule. Tenal Pab-anka-arpaged-ukchadbal, tegin an-Pabga-immal-imanaidbal, an oyonaido, Pab an-palmial.
Tenal Pab-an-palmialid aga tukin ankin chunmadi-kus antin a-tule. Tenal pemal Pab-chunmaked-kwen-itoszhulmal, tegin pemal Pab-pel-takchajulmalbal.
“Tenal pemal kwen ibzhaszhulmal-choggu Pab an-palmial, al Pab-pemalga-chogzhaddin pemal-ulubgin kwen peszhul.

“Tenal pemal ebinzhemal, Pab-kartagin-turdanaidbal pemal wisgune, pe igi ilagwen-nadgu tullegal. Al pemal pela-pela Pab-kartagin turdananimal. Tenal pemal nabir turdananimalando, tenal Pab-karta ankin chunmanai.
Tenal pemal yabli anche yapa tagmal ilagwen-nadgu tullegal.”
Tegin Jesús Judiomalga chogalbal: “Imi antin, an tule-an-nug-otummomalad-kwen-abingenai-chul.
Tenal an pemal-wismal, pemal ulubgin Pab-kwen-pilalzhulmal.
Tenal antin, an-Pab-nuggin nonido, tenal pemal an-kwen-abingaszhulmal. Tenal tule kujal aga tukin tanikil, pemal we tule-abingemalo.
“Tenal pemal aga emal-emal aminanimal aga nug otummogal. Tenal pemal Pab-Tummad-walkwénnagwad-kwen-aminanijulmal pe-nug-otummogal. ¿Tede pemalde, igi ankin ibzhenonimalo-wede? Keg kue.

“Tenal pemal ankin kwen ibzhaszhulmal-choggu, al pe melle ankin pinzhemalo, an Pabga pemal-tuktinemal. Tenal pe Moisés-igalgin-pe-ibzheedbal, pe chogmal: ‘Imi anmal keg-chulgu Pab-negzhe tognemal.’ Tenal pemal-nuekwa-nanaszhulidbal Moisés Pab Tummadga pemal-tuktimalo.
“Tenal pemal Moisés-penzhul-kujalen, pemal ampa ankin penzhul-kunonimalmogan. ¿Ibiga an teob pemalga chog? Imi Moisés pél ankin nermas.
Tenal pe Moisés-nermajadbal, pe pengus-choggu, ¿tede pe igi an-chogzhiidgin ibzhenonimalmogo? Keg kue. Pitomalgu.”
